'''Farquar III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
It was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was the location of a [[Battle of Farquar III|battle]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Separatist forces, as the Republic attempted to destroy a [[Farquar droid factory|droid factory]] that had been built on the planet.
